title: 第1章 练气一层卡了二十年？破鼎入体
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
“陈青山，你今年多大了？”

    废器房当院，铁三爷端着茶碗，眯着眼问。

    陈青山垂着手站在最前头，恭恭敬敬：“回三爷的话，二十六。”

    “二十六。”铁三爷咂了口茶，慢悠悠地点头，“进宗门也有二十年了吧？”

    “是。”

    “二十年，练气一层。”

    铁三爷把这两个数咬得很重，说完自己先笑了。

    院子里二十来个杂役，跟着哄堂大笑。

    笑声撞在四面土墙上，又弹回来，震得房梁上的灰簌簌往下掉。

    站在前排的张猛笑的最响，还扭头冲身边人挤眉弄眼，仿佛这点谈资是他叔叔特意赏给他的。

    陈青山低着头，没动。

    这种话前身听了二十年。从“废灵根”到“费钱货”，翻来覆去就那么几句，早听出茧子了。

    人活到一定份上，连脸红都嫌费力气。被人当众踩两脚，疼的早就不是脸，是肚子里那口咽不下、又吐不出的气。

    “行了。”铁三爷摆摆手，笑够了才开口，“本月月考，老规矩。每人五十斤精铁，三日为限。”

    “交不上来的——”他顿了顿，目光从陈青山脸上刮过去，“月俸减半。”

    队伍里响起一片倒吸气的声音。

    五十斤精铁，对练气二层、三层的人是累。对陈青山这种废灵根、练气一层的，是要命。

    废器房的月俸，是十颗辟谷丹。一颗顶十天不饿。

    交得上活儿，丹药到手；交不上，铁三爷一句话，他这个月就得饿着肚子熬炉。

    上个月他拼死凑了三十斤，垫了底。十颗辟谷丹，被扣得只剩三颗。

    那三颗，他硬生生熬了大半个月，夜里饿醒过两回，肚子贴着后脊梁，打坐都坐不稳。

    “都散了，干活去。”铁三爷把茶碗一搁。

    杂役们呼啦一下散开，各回各的炉子。

    陈青山刚要走，铁三爷又叫住他。

    “你留下。”

    陈青山心里咯噔一下，转过身。

    铁三爷从袖里慢吞吞摸出一个小布袋，掂了掂，扔在他脚边。

    “这月的月俸，先支你。”

    陈青山弯腰捡起。

    布袋瘪瘪的，入手就不对。他解开绳口往里一看，三颗黄褐色的辟谷丹，孤零零滚在袋底。

    该是十颗。

    “三爷……”他抬起头，“是不是数错了？”

    “数错？”铁三爷眼皮一翻，“你上个月月考垫底，三十斤都凑不齐，还有脸要满俸？”

    “能给你三颗，是看你二十年没功劳也有苦劳。”铁三爷哼了一声，“嫌少？嫌少你交够五十斤精铁来。”

    陈青山张了张嘴。

    道理他都懂。月考垫底要扣俸，这是废器房的规矩。

    可上个月扣了七颗，这个月活儿还没干，怎么又只发三颗？

    这分明是一茬一茬地扣，扣下来的辟谷丹，铁三爷转手就能拿去坊市换灵石。

    他心里跟明镜似的。

    这老东西扣的不是七颗丹，是把他往死里耗——耗到他熬不住、滚出废器房，那个炉子、那间屋子，就能腾出来安插自己人。这套路，铁三爷玩了不止他一个。

    可明白又能怎么样？

    他练气一层，铁三爷练气五层。一个照面，对方一根手指头就能把他摁死在炉子上。

    讨？

    拿什么讨。说理？这宗门最底下的废器房，从来就没有讲理的地方。

    陈青山把布袋攥紧，重新垂下头：“……弟子明白了。”

    “明白就好。”铁三爷端起茶碗，慢悠悠踱回主屋。

    走出两步，又像是想起什么，回头补了一句。

    “对了，后院废器库三年没人清了，今晚你去理一理。理不出来，这三颗也别揣着了。”

    说完，袖子一甩，进屋了。

    陈青山站在原地，攥着那三颗辟谷丹，指节都泛了白。

    “啧啧啧。”

    旁边飘来一道阴阳怪气的声音。

    张猛。

    铁三爷的亲侄子，练气三层，仗着叔叔是管事，在废器房里横着走。

    “二十年练气一层，月俸扣的就剩三颗。”张猛踱过来，居高临下地看着他，啧啧摇头，“陈青山，你这废材，活着不嫌丢人？”

    陈青山没抬头。

    王二装作添炭，李四低头捡钳子，几个爱看热闹的杂役，都把脸别了开去。

    不是没听见。是不敢听见。

    在废器房，替一个废物说半句话，比少熔一斤精铁还招祸。

    陈青山心里反倒凉得很稳。
content_en:
"Chen Qingshan, how old are you this year?"

    In the abandoned equipment room, Mr. Tie Sanye asked with squinted eyes while holding a tea bowl.

    Chen Qingshan stood at the front with his hands lowered and said respectfully, "In reply to Third Master, twenty-six."

    "Twenty-six." Master Tie San sipped his tea and nodded slowly, "It's been twenty years since you joined the sect, right?"

    "Yes."

    "Twenty years, one level of Qi training."

    Mr. Tiesan said these two numbers very seriously, and he laughed first after saying it.

    The twenty or so handymen in the yard burst into laughter.

    The laughter hit the four earthen walls and bounced back, causing the dust on the beams to fall down.

    Zhang Meng, who was standing in the front row, laughed the loudest and turned his head to wink at the people around him, as if his uncle had specially given him this little talking point.

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head and did not move.

    I have been hearing this for twenty years. From "waste spiritual roots" to "costly goods", just a few words are repeated over and over again, and I have already heard the cocoon.

    When a person lives to a certain extent, even blushing is too much effort. Being stepped on twice in public, the pain was no longer on the face, but on the breath in the stomach that couldn't be swallowed or exhaled.

    "Okay." Third Master Tie waved his hand and smiled after enough before he spoke, "This month's monthly test is the same as usual. Each person has fifty kilograms of fine iron, limited to three days."

    "If you can't pay it in -" he paused and glanced across Chen Qingshan's face, "the monthly salary will be halved."

    There was a gasp in the team.

    Fifty pounds of refined iron is tiring for people on the second or third level of Qi training. For someone like Chen Qingshan who has lost his spiritual roots and practiced Qi at the first level, it would be fatal.

    The monthly salary of the Waste Equipment Room is ten Bigu Pills. One pill lasts ten days without hunger.

    If he can hand in the work, he will get the elixir; if he can't, if Master Tie Sanye just says a word, he will have to stay hungry this month.

    Last month, he worked hard to gain 30 pounds, which was the bottom line. Out of ten Bigu Pills, only three were left.

    He had to endure those three pills for more than half a month. He woke up from hunger twice during the night. His stomach was pressed against his back and he couldn't sit still while meditating.

    "It's all gone, let's go to work." Tie Sanye put down the tea bowl.

    The handymen dispersed with a roar, each going back to his own stove.

    Just as Chen Qingshan was about to leave, Third Master Tie stopped him again.

    "You stay."

    Chen Qingshan's heart skipped a beat and turned around.

    Mr. Tie San slowly took out a small cloth bag from his sleeve, weighed it and threw it at his feet.

    "This month's salary will be paid to you first."

    Chen Qingshan bent down and picked it up.

    If the bag is flat, it is not the right thing to buy. He untied the rope and looked inside. Three yellow-brown Bigu Pills rolled alone at the bottom of the bag.

    It should be ten.

    "Third Master..." He raised his head, "Did you count wrongly?"

    "Wrong count?" Mr. Tie San rolled his eyelids, "You were last in the monthly exam last month and couldn't even get thirty kilograms together. How can you still afford to pay for your salary?"

    "I can give you three because you have worked hard for twenty years without any merit." Mr. Tie San snorted, "Too few? If it's too few, you can hand over fifty kilograms of fine iron."

    Chen Qingshan opened his mouth.

    He understands everything. Those who finish the monthly exam will have their salary deducted. This is the rule of the waste equipment room.

    But seven pills were deducted last month, and I haven’t done any work this month, so why are only three pills issued?

    This was obviously taken one after another, and the bigu pills that were taken away could be exchanged for spiritual stones by Mr. Tie Sanye in the market.

    He felt like a mirror in his mind.

    What this old guy wants is not to take seven pills, but to consume him to death - to the point where he can't stand it any longer and gets out of the waste room, so that the stove and that room can be freed up to house his own people. Tie Sanye was not the only one to pull this trick.

    But what can I do if I understand?

    He has practiced Qi at the first level, and Tie Sanye has practiced Qi at the fifth level. In one confrontation, the other party could pin him to death on the stove with just one finger.

    discuss?

    What to ask for. Reason? There has never been any room for reason in this useless room at the bottom of the sect.

    Chen Qingshan clenched the bag tightly and lowered his head again: "...disciple understands."

    "As long as you understand." Mr. Tie Sanye picked up the tea bowl and walked slowly back to the main room.

    After taking two steps, he seemed to remember something and turned back to add something.

    "By the way, no one has cleaned out the waste weapons warehouse in the backyard for three years. Go and sort it out tonight. If you can't sort it out, don't carry these three."

    After saying that, he tossed his sleeves and entered the house.

    Chen Qingshan stood there, clutching the three Bigu Pills, his knuckles turned white.

    "Tsk, tsk, tsk."

    A strange voice floated from the side.

    Zhang Meng.

    Mr. Tie Sanye's nephew, a third-level qi practitioner, walked sideways in the scrap room because his uncle was in charge.

    "After twenty years of practicing Qi, you only get three pills from your monthly salary." Zhang Meng walked over, looked at him condescendingly, and shook his head, "Chen Qingshan, you are a good-for-nothing, don't you feel ashamed to be alive?"

    Chen Qingshan did not raise his head.

    Wang Er pretended to make trouble, Li Si lowered his head to pick up the pliers, and several handymen who liked to watch the fun turned their faces away.

    It’s not that I didn’t hear it. I dare not hear it.

    In the scrap room, saying a word for a waste is more likely to cause trouble than missing a pound of fine iron from melting.

    Chen Qingshan felt very cold in his heart.
title_en: Chapter 1 The first level of Qi training has been stuck for twenty years? Break into the body
